comment: Pin of the upstream USDM-RDF this domain vendors (ADR-0029). Source of truth = github.com/kerfors/usdm-rdf (Kerstin Forsberg), the w3id.org/cdisc/usdm/v4/ namespace's canonical community artifact. Watch for a new release + assess impact with: python3 cr-domain/tools/usdm-rdf-gen/check_upstream.py. Absorb deliberately (re-vendor the files, re-run the crosswalk resolution check, update the sha256s + pinned_version here).
